sources: https://www.heardcountyga.com/brushCreek.html (Heard County: Chattahoochee Old Town aka Brush Creek Park - fees, reservations, stay limits, phone), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Sites with hookups $35 a day ($400 a month); primitive sites $20 a day; tent camping $20 a day (no monthly rentals for either). Daily park fee $5 per car (2 adults; $2 each extra adult or child over 10) and a $35 season park pass are listed separately; the county does not say whether campers pay them.

fees.source: https://www.heardcountyga.com/brushCreek.html ('Campground Fees: per Day per Month Sites and Hook Ups $35.00 $400.00 Primitive Sites $20.00 No Monthly Rentals Tent Camping $20.00', 'Daily Park Fees $5.00 per Car with a 2 adult maximum') + Park Rules and Regulations v2026.pdf (same figures), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Reserve through the Park Manager, (706) 594-4921, up to 30 days ahead; the reservation is guaranteed when the fee is received. 30 days on a site, extendable unless someone else has reserved it; no more than 60 consecutive days, then 30 days out of the park. Park gate locked 10 pm to 7 am.

booking.source: https://www.heardcountyga.com/brushCreek.html ('Campers are allowed to reserve a site for 30 days (up to 30 day in advance). Reservation is guaranteed when fee is received by the Park Manager.', 'No camper may stay in the park for more than 60 consecutive days', 'The Park Gate closes at 10:00 PM and will not reopen until 7:00 AM') + rules PDF ('Contact Number 706-594-4921'), read 2026-10-30

note: Heard County park on West Point Lake, officially Chattahoochee Old Town Park (aka Brush Creek Park). Large sites (30+ yds apart), bathhouses, boat ramp and direct lake access, ballfields and playground. Gray water may not run on the ground. --Claude
summary: Heard County's own page (the stored franklingeorgia.com site no longer resolves) gives $35 hookup / $20 primitive a day, $400 a month, reservations by the Park Manager up to 30 days out, 60-day max: fees unset -> 20-35, booking added. County silent on amperage, site count and dump (derived values left). Note cleaned ($25 wrong; field facts and RV Life line dropped).
flags: Website dead: franklingeorgia.com does not resolve (DNS SERVFAIL). County's page: https://www.heardcountyga.com/brushCreek.html (rules PDF https://www.heardcountyga.com/Park%20Rules%20and%20Regulations%20v2026.pdf).
Phone: the county gives the park (706) 594-4921 ('Contact Number' on the rules PDF and park page); stored 706-675-2267 is not on the county's pages.
Name: the county now calls it 'Chattahoochee Old Town Park' ('Chattahoochee Old Town aka Brush Creek Park').

Long-stay leaning: monthly hookup rate $400 and 30-day site rentals extendable to 60 days. The county posts a nightly ($35/day) rate and takes reservations by phone, so test 2 passes; the share of nightly campers is not stated.

Base: $20 is the primitive-site rate; the county lists primitive sites separately from tent camping and allows only 'R.V.'s, campers, and tents', but does not say how long a rig a primitive site takes. If primitive sites are tent-scale, the base is $35.

Waterfront re-audit lead (stored not waterfront): winter-drawdown imagery shows RVs parked on the open grassy point at about 33.2050,-85.0850, roughly 40-60 m from the drawdown waterline and closer at full pool; the county page gives no site map, so the pads could not be located one by one.

Pin: stored 33.207,-85.083 sits inside the park's developed area north of the point; with no site map I could not measure it against the pads (Google's 'Brush Creek Recreation Area' point 33.2112,-85.0870 is on the entrance road in the woods).
